result.title: ClinVerse: A Realistic Multi-Agent Diagnostic Environment for Training and Evaluating Medical Agents
result.summary: Disease diagnosis is a key application of large language model (LLM) agents in healthcare. However, existing medical agents are primarily trained and evaluated with static question-answering data, providing limited opportunities to learn active information acquisition, examination decision-making, and dynamic clinical interaction. To address this limitation, we present ClinVerse, an interactive, real-data-grounded multi-agent environment designed for training and evaluating medical diagnostic agents. Built on ClinPatient, a scalable dataset comprising 150k diagnostic cases derived from real-world electronic health records, ClinVerse supports coordinated interactions among six specialized clinical roles. Specifically, a doctor agent starts from an initial patient complaint, progressively gathers clinical evidence through patient interviews and examination requests, and ultimately produces a diagnosis. For each interaction trajectory, a rule-based scoring framework quantifies information acquisition, examination ordering, and diagnostic accuracy. These trajectory-level scores serve as reward signals for agent training while also enabling scalable evaluation. In experiments, we evaluate various general-purpose and medical-domain models and show that nine self-evolution methods across three categories consistently improve agents' diagnostic capabilities within ClinVerse. We further analyze the interplay among model capability, environment feedback, and self-evolution methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ClinVerse：基于约 15 万真实电子病历病例、支持六类临床角色协同交互的诊断环境，医生智能体从主诉出发逐步通过问诊与检查申请采集证据并给出诊断，并用规则化轨迹评分（信息获取、检查排序、诊断准确率）作为训练奖励与评测指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作为纯文本临床环境、无视觉输入，但其对检查申请顺序、证据获取与诊断终点的轨迹级奖励设计，可能为 LVR 中「LOOK/STOP」式的证据筛选与停止决策建模提供可供核查的线索。
